rationale: The Evaluator feedback suggests that the previous candidate implemented increases in ki and adjustments to kp to reduce overshoot and improve steady-state error correction, but without race telemetry, the effects are unconfirmed. To address this, I have set ki to 0.4 (slightly higher than before) to further improve integral correction and reduced kp to 7 to lower overshoot and oscillations. I also decreased base_speed slightly to 1.4 to enhance stability and reduce line loss events, as recommended. kd is increased back to 3 to improve damping of oscillations. Sensor weights are adjusted to [-1.2, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.2] to reduce the influence of outer sensors and potentially lower oversteering. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to evaluate the impact of these changes on stability, line tracking, and overall performance.
